name: Historical Decolonization - Player and AI
author: Local RTW3 Mod Tools
description: Adds date-led historical independence for player and AI empires, and blocks random secession from core regions and territories with a scheduled release. Western USA and the other U.S. home regions are protected. Scheduled transfers still occur only in their listed year and only while held by a listed administrator; the mod's own dated transfers bypass the guard. Other native possession events remain active. Independent territories become Neutral. Experimental; see Mods/Manager/DECOLONIZATION.md.
